diagnosis: The customer's higher invoice is due to mid-cycle proration upon upgrading to the Business plan, which combines credits for the old plan and charges for the new one. This is expected behavior for the first invoice after an upgrade and does not require escalation.
reply: Hello, thank you for reaching out regarding your recent invoice. The amount you see is higher than the standard plan price because your upgrade to the Business plan occurred mid-billing cycle. This results in a prorated charge that combines a credit for the unused days on your previous plan with the charge for the new plan for the remainder of the cycle. You can read more about how this calculation works in our article on understanding mid-cycle proration.
